metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a C++20 command-line simulator in [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp) with [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt). It builds with `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` from `output/`, accepts the required CLI flags, writes the final-state JSON, optionally writes the trace JSON, and supports parameter/tool-file loading plus success-only parameter-file output.

I built it and ran a smoke test with a simple `G1 X1 F60` program. The binary built successfully and produced the expected final state plus a stepped trace with delta entries. I did not run an exhaustive conformance suite against the full RS274 spec, so if you have harness cases beyond the spec examples, those are the next thing to run.
